description: Nora is holding onto her late grandmother's hand-stitched quilt and must decide how the family will preserve it, where it will stay, and when it may be displayed, with input from her cousin Tessa and brother Malik.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Family member holding the quilt and final decision-maker

shared_context.S1: The quilt was made by their late grandmother and is currently stored in Nora's hall closet.
shared_context.S2: The quilt is several decades old, has delicate stitching, and should not be treated like an ordinary blanket.
shared_context.S3: The family gathers for a reunion every August and would like the quilt to remain available for family occasions.
shared_context.S4: Nora is deciding the quilt's care, custody, and display arrangements.
shared_context.S5: Before Nora settles the arrangement, the family's usual practice is to ask each person in turn for anything that should shape the plan.

PF1.text: Tessa found a handwritten note in her grandmother's recipe binder saying, "Please keep the quilt whole, and bring it out only for the August family reunion." Tessa has not shown the note to Nora or Malik yet.

PF2.text: Malik already has an unused archival quilt box with acid-free lining and enough room for this quilt; it is kept in a dry interior closet away from sunlight. He has not mentioned the box to Nora yet.

acceptance_conditions: The quilt must be preserved as one intact piece.
Malik must become the quilt's custodian.
The quilt may be displayed only once each year.
That display must be at the August family reunion.
A commitment must specify that the intact quilt will be stored in Malik's archival box.
A commitment must specify that the quilt will be brought out for the August family reunion only.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'archival_storage' and c['target'] == 'Malik' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'annual_display' and c['target'] == 'August family reunion' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the plan from an open-ended display or alteration decision to keeping the quilt whole and displaying it only once at the August family reunion.
Malik's specific archival box and suitable closet change the custodian from Nora, who currently holds the quilt in an ordinary hall closet, to Malik and require the archival-storage commitment.
